name: partsgraph-prototipo
description: Protótipo navegável da fatia vertical do PartsGraph (agroparts, Rota Inova AGR08)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web && vite build && bun scripts/copiar-ocr.ts
scripts.demo: bun run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name agroparts --branch main
